title: The Hidden Night Shift
narration: While you lie still, your brain is racing. A fleet of janitors. This is sleep. And it saves your life. [sigh] Every night, without fail.
visual_goal: Close-up of a sleeping person, then a surreal tunnel inside the brain with glowing cleaning agents moving along pathways.

title: The 24-Hour Clock
narration: Your body runs on a 24-hour clock. The circadian rhythm. Inside your brain, twenty thousand neurons. They tell every cell when to sleep.
visual_goal: Animated 24-hour dial with a glowing core in the brain, neural pulses radiating out.

title: You Need 7 Hours
narration: Adults need at least 7 hours. Not 6, not 5. Seven. That's the benchmark. Less? Your mind becomes a fog.
visual_goal: Large bold '7' on screen, split screen showing sharp vs blurred thinking.

title: Your Brain's Wash
narration: Remember the janitors. The glymphatic system. While you sleep, fluid flushes out waste. Toxic proteins. Garbage. Gone.
visual_goal: Brain cross-section with blue fluid flowing through channels, flushing away orange waste particles.

title: More Than a Record
narration: But what if you skip it? The longest anyone stayed awake? 11 days. Randy Gardner, 1964. Science project. But centuries of pain.
visual_goal: Archival-style photo montage of a young man, clock ticking, then a dark somber frame.

title: Your Memory Feels It
narration: Sleep deprivation hits your attention. Your working memory. Simple tasks become mountains. Focus? Shattered.
visual_goal: Split screen: a sharp-minded person doing a puzzle vs a dazed person struggling.

title: Deep Waves
narration: And then there's deep sleep. Slow waves. Half a hertz. Almost flat. This is when memories get saved. When the brain files away the day.
visual_goal: An EEG line tracing low-frequency waves, then files being neatly sorted into a cabinet.

title: Dreams on REM
narration: Then REM. Eyes dart. Body still. Vivid dreams. But it's not just fun. It's a neurological workshop.
visual_goal: Animated person with moving eyes under eyelids, dream imagery floating above the head.

title: Trim Your Synapses
narration: But your brain also prunes. Cut unused connections. Keep what matters. Sleep trims the garden. That's the synaptic down-selection.
visual_goal: A neural garden where some synapses are snipped away neatly, others strengthened.

title: Protect Your Heart
narration: Skimp on sleep. And your heart pays. Your body pays. Obesity, diabetes, heart disease. Sleep isn't lazy. It's survival.
visual_goal: A tired person holding their chest, then a rising sun over a vibrant landscape of a healthy sleeper.
